task.description: WF-06 round 1, lens execution: write runs/WF06-20260926-01/assessment-execution.json per design §4.5 — score every candidate on cost_to_test and build_fit, 1-5, each with at least one verbatim quote from runs/WF06-20260926-01/sources/.
acceptance_criteria: every quote is verbatim from a cleaned copy

result.summary:
Round 1, lens execution (cost_to_test / build_fit):
01-kviz-zayavki: 4 / 4 — cheap manual 2–4 week test gated on '2 of 3 pay'; signal depends on the businesses' own ads and on 3 acquaintances; engine must be rewritten (Advisor code not reusable); WhatsApp-to-owner needs a paid gateway.
02-sai: 5 / 3 — cheapest, fastest test (no code, 1–2 weeks, 20 shops, paid pilot as threshold); heaviest quality-bar load of the buildable ideas (R3 photos, Q10 try-on API, Q8), per-item measurements from shops, 35–40 ₸ per image (10 000 ₸ pilot ≈ 250–285 images).
03-zhivoy-most: 2 / 4 — no test plan, no known payer, narrow audience; hook-based base already works and matches R2, but depends on the platform's hook format.
04-kamery-kpp: 1 / 1 — enterprise sales with on-site hardware; no base for computer vision/biometrics; Q3/Q4 hard to meet on site.
Limitation: the project directory name and the quality bar's examples (shops, try-on service, customer photos) reveal that 02 became the project; scored on source facts only. Other analysts' files were not read in this round.
Self-check (all three lens files present): `npm run --silent validate -- ../runs/WF06-20260926-01 --stage assessments` -> `OK WF06-20260926-01 (stage assessments)`, exit=0.
